description: Key financial facts for one SEC-reporting company from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings: revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, equity, shares outstanding, operating cash flow and EPS, latest annual and quarterly, plus as-of date and source link. US-GAAP financial statements only (plus the dei cover-page share count); companies that report in IFRS are not supported and return 404. Company facts only. Data from SEC EDGAR; not affiliated with or endorsed by the SEC. Not investment advice. Price $0.02 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).
